# VERDICT Platforms

> Canonical dataset and published evaluation reports for VERDICT, an
> independent AI agent trust evaluation index. Framework v0.3.1.
> Individual reports are NOT enumerated here: resolve them via the
> naming convention plus the single index entrypoint below. This keeps
> this file O(1) as the report count grows.

## Authority order

canonical (this repo) > compiled brief > Project Knowledge bootstrap.
On divergence, this repo's files win.

## Index entrypoint

- [Platforms index](data/platforms.json): the authoritative list of all
  evaluated platforms with current state. Fetch this FIRST, then resolve
  individual files via the naming convention below.

## Naming convention (resolve individual files; do not enumerate)

- Evaluation report: `evaluations/{NNN}_{slug}.md`  (NNN = zero-padded number)
- Platform canonical: `platforms/{slug}.md`
- Evaluation schema:  `data/schema.json`
- Rankings:           `rankings/{overall|by-tier|by-category|cisa-kev}.md`

## Notes

- Public, source-cited, public-data-only evaluations.
- The schema in `data/schema.json` is the front-matter contract.
